text: ts better. we can move to the next piece
resolution: Built the self-serve rebindable hotkeys the user asked for ('if i dont like the hotkey i dont have to go ask anyone — its in the settings'), on the existing editor control contract. controls.ts gains a user-override map layering over the defaults (resolve/legend/tooltips all read bindingsForScope so a rebind updates every surface), setUserBinding validates + rejects in-scope clashes as a warning not a crash, plus load/export, a capture-suppression flag (so binding Delete can't also delete), and prettyChord — all pure/import-free so the contract stays headless-testable. keybinds.ts persists the map via localstore (kept out of controls.ts); loadKeybinds() hydrates at boot. HotkeysPanel.tsx is a modal listing each action's name + chord + Rebind(press-a-key) + Reset, conflict shown inline, opened by a new Keyboard toolbar button. Added 5 P4 cases to controls.test.ts (11/11 pass via esbuild+v8cli). Built green + self-shot boots clean. Needs a live check: open the Keyboard button, rebind a key, reload, confirm it sticks (modal interaction can't be self-shot headless). SHAs e35a4210c.
